summary: Intchains Group filed a 6-K furnishing its H1 2026 results and disclosing a $15 million share repurchase program (the US-equivalent open-market buyback authorization for this foreign private issuer). No share count, price, premium, or expiry is stated, and no advisor or board recommendation is named. Context: H1 revenue RMB11.1 million against RMB42.0 million opex, net loss RMB1.22 per share, RMB461.1 million cash and short-term investments, and a new mining ASIC tape-out targeting Q4 2026 launch. Watch repurchase execution pace versus cash burn and the ASIC validation timeline.
